items.desc_now: DeepSeek Harness 主程序与插件更新管理：npm/GitHub 双源 semver 比对、多语言横幅、一键更新（主程序自动备份/校验/回滚，插件临时目录安装）、更新后看门狗重启。Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: dual-source semver checks, locale banner, one-click updates with backup/rollback, watchdog restart.
items.desc_prev: 全栈更新管理：对 DeepSeek Harness 主程序与每个已装第三方插件做 npm/GitHub 双源 semver 比对，GUI 横幅随系统语言（中/英）提示可更新插件；一键更新主程序或任意插件，自动备份可回滚，更新后看门狗自动重启服务。Whole-stack update management for DeepSeek Harness: dual-source semver checks of the main program and every third-party plugin, a locale-aware banner, one-click updates with backup/rollback and watchdog-guarded restart.
